title: SparkDeltaPrime
tagline: Optimizes user liquidity by placing liquidity, leveraging capital managers through zk proofs, generating effective and sustainable returns.
description:
SparkDeltaPrime Optimizes user liquidity by placing liquidity on the borrower and lender side, thus leveraging capital managers through zk proofs, meaning that not neccesary immediate verification, the main goal is to generate effective and sustainable returns.

We are planning to use some of the protocols, given starting with spark the integration will allow users for borrowing and lending.
